html:
If you’re looking to get car tinting and wondering how much does car window tinting cost?, speak to a team of experts at your local Tint a Car. With a range of film options to match virtually any budget, we can help you pick the right film and help you understand how much does it cost to tint windows.

How Much Does Window Tinting Cost?

Window tinting doesn’t have to be expensive. With different films to choose from, each of our range offer exceptional value, at different price points.

  • Octane – with up to 99% UV solar protection and available in 2 exclusive colour shades, Octane is our darkest legal window tint for those who want exceptional levels of privacy.
  • Spectre – using innovative ceramic technology, Spectre offers superior heat rejection and fade resistance to keep your car interior cool and protected for longer.

How Much Does It Cost To Get Car Windows Tinted?

Locate your nearest store for an obligation free quote to learn how much window tinting costs. With many stores located across the nation, we can work with you to find out the best window tint for your individual lifestyle needs and provide real answers relevant to you.
